gates.evidence: The proposal uses the Chats Home surface, which is a general chat interface, not flagged as NSFW or sensitive.
The reward is for playing a 15-second sponsored game (SIM-RWD), not for clicking ads or installing apps.
The proposal offers a positive 'Daily tasks' incentive without using loss framing or dark patterns.
The user must tap 'Play task' on the daily tasks sheet to start.
The proposal clearly states: 'Play three 15-second sponsored games today to unlock 30 minutes of Upgrade to Luzia+'.
The user has a 'Close' option on the daily tasks sheet and can return to Chats Home without penalty.
The trigger is a proactive hub (Chats Home), not an interruption to an ongoing conversation or response.
Eligibility is explicitly set to 'Non-payers only'.

scores.evidence: The reward provides a 'taste' of the Luzia+ subscription. While powerful, it is a proactive hub rather than a reactive fix at the exact moment of a cap hit (e.g., reactive refill).
The design is very native, adding a task list proactively without disrupting core chat flows or existing free utility.
The reward is time-boxed (30 minutes) and capped daily (3 tasks for 1 use), which is safer than permanent capacity. It gates only to non-payers.
Revenue per view ($0.009-$0.015) vs 30 minutes of access. The cost to serve is within reason for 3 impressions per daily unlock.
The trigger is on the core Chats Home tab, ensuring high daily visibility for the entire user base.
Uses the standard SIM-RWD unit and existing app navigation structure.
Excellent use of Luzia's own screen names ('Chats Home'), terminology ('Luzia+', 'Custom Bestie'), and economy.
Explicit daily cap of 3 tasks and a 5-minute cooldown between offers prevents nagging.
Primary metric (Tasks per DAU), guardrails, and a user-level holdout are defined.

parsed.topConcern: None; the proposal is shippable as designed.
